impact: Political scrutiny keeps a governance overhang on NVDA and the AI chip trade ahead of its Nov 17 earnings, a sentiment risk for MU, DRAM and NBIS.
summary: Democrats in Congress are pressing for oversight after Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a woman US intelligence believes was a Chinese state security asset. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called it a significant issue of concern; Nvidia says Huang will keep leading without interruption.
title: Congress Democrats press Nvidia on Huang affair, Jeffries flags concern
